_comment: The OpenSearch clients this library claims to capture at the transport, in their own manifest. They cannot go in the root require-dev: opensearch-php requires PHP 8.2 and this library's floor is 7.4, so `composer update` would stop working on three of the seven versions in the matrix. Only ClientCaptureTest reads this tree, and it skips when the tree is absent.
_no_lock: Deliberately unlocked, unlike tools/infection. The point of this harness is to notice when a client changes what it transports over, and a pinned lock would hide exactly that. `composer update` here is the check.
